entries.7b3debf2e8d35e6a: This is a cloud-based reservation management system for hair and beauty salons. It provides creation of a salon's official smartphone app, Web reservations, unified management (site controller) that automates reservation management across multiple customer-attraction sites, the payment function "BeautyMerit Pay," EC functions, data analysis functions and more. As of the end of March 2026, it is used by 9,400 or more stores. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.7b5f72112de16ec9: The [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed, etc.] section shows that, according to the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry’s “Reiwa 6 Fiscal Year Report on Market Survey of Electronic Commerce,” the online reservation market for hair and beauty services grew from ¥242.0 billion in 2015 to ¥730.2 billion in 2024, and that in the hair and beauty industry, competition among salons has intensified, chronic labor shortages have become serious, and the computerization of salon management is accelerating.
entries.8e510bfa2f2f7dc8: The online reservation market for hair and beauty services continues to expand; according to a survey by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, it had grown to ¥730.2 billion in 2024.
